apps.name: Mirage
apps.subtitle: Teleport your location anywhere.
apps.localizedDescription: Native iOS location spoofer with real GPS override, live joystick, route simulation (GPX), and a WiFi fallback.

versions.localizedDescription: Three fixes from 3.3.0's new features. Backtrack now returns to your real starting location instead of the previous spoofed spot: after stopping a spoof and starting a new one, the origin was captured from a stale coordinate. Places and Settings stay reachable while spoofing — the live card was covering the search orb, so a search orb now sits in the right-edge rail whenever the big orb is hidden. And the Backtrack quick action no longer overflows its tile; it reads "Backtrack", with the full destination name kept on the map's wide button.

Retrace your steps, share a spot, and a cleaner face. Backtrack: a spoof remembers where it began, so returning is one tap — Back to <place> on the live card and in Places, offered only when there's an origin to return to. Share: every place card gains a Share button beside Teleport and Save, handing off the coordinate and a Maps link. Places, rebuilt: quick actions up top to paste a coordinate, drop a pin or backtrack; saved spots, routes and recents in grouped cards; and a real empty state with a paste shortcut instead of text over a void. A live status card in Settings shows spoofing state, place, coordinate and link health first instead of last, with a soft pulse while live. Redesigned sign-in and onboarding: one dark world with the pin as the hero and a solid button, replacing a gate whose fields clashed and whose button looked disabled. Fixed: tapping a point of interest now drops your pin or a route waypoint instead of popping Apple's place card (which sometimes even opened Safari); and the VPN link is tidier across reconnects.

Public transport that rides real track. Tram, metro, train and ferry journeys now follow the actual line through the actual stops instead of the road beside it: you walk to a real stop, ride the real geometry, and walk off at the far end. Built from each region's own GTFS feed — the Netherlands ships inside the app, and Berlin and Milan can be added from Settings → Public transport. Journeys allow one change, and a train trip can be fed by a tram to reach the station. Pick a mode straight from the place card: tap More and bus, tram, metro and train sit beside Walk and Drive. The ETA counts the stops, since those are most of what separates a bus from a car over the same road. Buses stay on roads on purpose — a bus drives on the road, so road directions are already right for one, and it still stops and dwells like a bus. Fixed: train and metro journeys were refused for being too far from a stop, because one 800 m walking limit was applied to every mode; a journey that can't ride track now says which of four reasons applies instead of silently using the road; and “Saved” stays said instead of reverting after two seconds as though the save had failed.

Ride the bus, spoof without Wi-Fi, and stay where you teleported to. No Wi-Fi needed: Mirage used to tell you to find a hotspot even with a tunnel already up, and now recognises the tunnel as its own route — on an external tunnel you turn Mobile Data off for a few seconds to connect, then run with data back on. Public transport: bus, tram, metro and train that actually stop, waiting at each stop and easing in and out rather than cruising through. Your pairing file is now saved to Files (On My iPhone → Mirage → Pairing) and can be shared off the phone, so reinstalling no longer means redoing the pairing. Fixed: a new teleport no longer snaps back to the previous one after ten seconds; Walk and Drive work on mobile data instead of animating a journey your phone never took; dismissing the Mobile Data prompt no longer leaves “Applying” on screen; a failed teleport shows its reason instead of hiding it behind the pin card, and Retry actually retries. Stopping a spoof no longer drops the tunnel, so teleporting again is fast.

Mirage v3.0 — the revamp. Light mode (warm paper, not inverted dark). New home screen: the bottom sheet is gone and the map gets its space back. Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Walk/Drive here now works from your real location after a confirmation. Map style swatches, a full-screen Places screen, km/h ↔ mph in Settings, and you can change speed while moving. Settings rebuilt. Considerably faster with a spoof running.

Mirage v2.8 — Walk/Drive here draws the route line and you can change speed while walking; new Liquid Glass bottom bar; save & replay routes; paste coordinates / Maps link; rename saved places; reliable pairing import. Fixes false license-server lockouts, raw tunnel errors, and 'Walk here' leaking your real location.
Mirage v2.6 — no computer required. On iOS 27 Mirage pairs with your iPhone itself: no Mac, no PC, no cable. Re-pair from Settings any time. IPA in the Discord for now.
Mirage v2.5 — Walk/Drive routing on real roads, natural speed variation, 5G session fixes, real-location exposure alerts. IPA in the Discord for now.
Mirage v2.4 — free-sideload signing awareness, tunnel UX, refreshed docs.
